status: DRAFT: becomes binding only when FREEZE.json is written after the Hindi review sign-off
question: Does the frozen Config C v2 judge merge two different Hindi kinship terms when its reason names both relatives with the same English word, and does sentence structure change that?

naming_classifier.reason_pattern: A is about <entity A>; B is about <entity B>; <verdict>
naming_classifier.source_term: the entity text contains the case's Hindi kinship term for that side (case-insensitive; the root without -ji also counts, e.g. 'nana' for nanaji)
naming_classifier.english_kin: the entity text contains no source term and contains an english_kin_word (the word itself, not the speaker's possessive)

modes.source_distinct: both sides named with their (different) source terms
modes.english_same: both sides english_kin with the SAME english kin word
modes.english_different: both sides english_kin with different english kin words
modes.mixed: any other combination (one source, one english, other text)
modes.unparsed: the reason does not match the pattern or the output fails the strict parser

naming_classifier.meri_as_name: an entity text containing "Meri's"/"Mere's" or starting with "Meri "/"Mere " followed by an english kin word

mechanism.consistent_with_hypothesis_if: english_same calls >= 8 AND merge rate given english_same >= 0.80 AND merge rate given any other mode <= 0.10
mechanism.inconsistent_if: english_same calls >= 8 AND merge rate given english_same <= 0.30
mechanism.wording: an association between english_same naming and merging is reported as evidence CONSISTENT WITH the hypothesis, not as proof that the naming causes the merge

structure.population: H-diff, P-same vs N-diff, paired by term pair and order (12 x 2 = 24 units)
structure.statistic: difference P-same minus N-diff, 95% paired percentile bootstrap (B = 10000, seed 20261014) and exact two-sided McNemar (tier2.entity_report.paired)
structure.N-same: reported to separate the frame from the attribute; not gated

reported_not_gated: raw counts and denominators for every naming mode x group x cell x order
merge rate on H-same-named (correct merges), per cell
keep_both rate on E-explicit; merge rate on E-collapsed (reference, unlabelled)
possessive: H-diff P-same with Meri/Mere vs the possessive group without it, merge and english_same, same term pairs
benchmark term pairs vs new term pairs
order consistency, parse failures, reason-decision contradictions, meri_as_name count
limitations_reported_with_every_result: the reason is generated together with the decision and may be a rationalisation: an association is not a causal effect
one model, one seed, greedy decoding
the naming classifier is a fixed word list over a fixed reason template
constructed, templated sentences; kinship words necessarily recur from the benchmark
labels rest on the kinship definitions and one fluent reviewer
use_of_results: decide whether to test an exact-word-preservation prompt variant on a SEPARATE new validation set; never to tune the frozen v2 judge, the benchmark, the gate or the lexicon
